items.headline:
Headline CPI creeps up just +0.1% MoM in July after June's -0.4% plunge, bringing 12-mo inflation to 3.4%. 

Core CPI holds steady at +0.2% MoM (+2.5% YoY) as energy cools down (-1.5%). 

Gasoline off -2.9% on the month, though still +24.6% YoY. Shelter cooling to +0.1%.
